# Rectangular carton sample guide

Use one folded paperboard insert for a flat rectangular studio sample and keep the sample serial visible in the cutout. This sheet does not cover wooden crates or oblong pieces.

## Caption strip
A caption strip can name a design, including the Vela cup outline, but must not claim a food-contact certificate. No jurisdiction-specific certificate for that new line is filed in this corpus.
